subject.title: fix: restore native new sessions and invariant UI counts

question: May bare `/new` require a Gateway with `sessions.create` and fail closed on older or unsupported Gateways, or must the Companion preserve a compatibility path or visible upgrade recovery?
rationale: The patch intentionally replaces the prior model-facing behavior with a protocol mutation, so source inspection alone cannot decide the supported Gateway compatibility policy.

options.title: Require native support with recovery
options.body: Keep the fail-closed design but add or prove a clear in-product unsupported-version message and upgrade path.

options.title: Preserve a compatibility fallback
options.body: Retain the previous model-facing behavior only when native session creation is unavailable, with tests showing that fallback cannot affect supported Gateways.

options.title: Accept the strict protocol boundary
options.body: Merge with the current behavior and explicitly document that bare `/new` requires the pinned supported Gateway version.

recommendation.title: Require native support with recovery
recommendation.body: Keep the fail-closed design but add or prove a clear in-product unsupported-version message and upgrade path.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level Gateway compatibility and Companion UX policy decision rather than a mechanical code repair.
